react.name: React
react.protocol: v1.0 through the web_core v1_0 module (the Basic lane of the gate runs v0.9)
react.m_level: M4 complete for the custom 670-atom lane; M5 not claimed
react.note: The reference renderer: the other web renderers are compared with it pixel for pixel. Its own pixel column is measured against itself.

source_info.protocol_recorded: Basic lane v0_9; custom lane v1_0 processor (v10 cases)

lit.name: Lit
lit.m_level: M4 complete for the custom 670-atom lane; M5 not claimed
lit.note: No v1.0 export exists for Lit, so v1.0 was not measured. Dark 360 px is not a gate lane for Lit.

angular.name: Angular
angular.m_level: M4 complete for the custom 670-atom lane; M5 not claimed
angular.note: Measured against the React lane on the same code; two identical runs plus a third run.

copilotkit.name: CopilotKit
copilotkit.m_level: M4 complete for the custom 670-atom lane; M5 not claimed
copilotkit.note: CopilotKit draws our atoms inside ITS wrapper and theme, so the custom-lane numbers measure whether the wrapper changes how our atoms look and behave, not CopilotKit's own components.

source_info.protocol_recorded: v0_9 (web_core 0.15.0); stock CopilotKit renderer, no host theme

a2ui-vue.name: a2ui-vue
a2ui-vue.m_level: M4 complete for the custom 670-atom lane; M5 not claimed
a2ui-vue.note: a2ui-vue draws our atoms inside ITS wrapper and theme, so the custom-lane numbers measure the wrapper, not a2ui-vue's own components. Vue-only pixel failures were not traced.

source_info.protocol_recorded: v0_9 (a2ui-vue own bundled processor, peer @a2ui/web_core ^0.9.1); stock a2ui-vue, no host theme

flutter.name: Flutter
flutter.m_level: below M4: custom lane partly covered, Basic lane not measured by us, no device run
flutter.note: Partial coverage: only a part of the atoms are ported to native Flutter widgets. Text parity with the web painter was checked on the atoms listed in the parity sweep; the Basic lane was not measured by us; no device run.
